media.title: Le Temps
media.evidence: OAIRecord dc:date 1931-05-15 (Numéro 25466); f1.item title 'Le Temps | 1931-05-15'. Gallica ContentSearch page 1: "L'Assemblée nationale a élu, hier, M. Paul Doumer, président de la République" (headline 'L'ÉLECTION DE M. PAUL DOUMER à la présidence de la République').

alternatives.title: President-Elect Of France Poses
alternatives.evidence: FALLBACK newsreel (no radio found). oEmbed 200, author 'British Movietone' (AP Archive official channel); description: '(18 May 1931) M Doumer, who secured nomination in competition with M Briand, makes his screen debut.' Shows the president-elect days after the vote; short English item, not a French announcement of the result.

searched: INA ina.fr search (audio+video: 'Doumer', 'Paul Doumer', 'élection Doumer', 'Doumer 1931', 'Doumer élu', 'Versailles 1931') - only unrelated 1930-31 newsreels and 1967 radio; Gallica SRU sound recordings 'Doumer' = 0 records; YouTube ('Paul Doumer élu président 1931', 'Doumer elected president 1931 Versailles', 'élection Paul Doumer 1931 actualités Gaumont', ArchivesRadio) - only British Pathé/Movietone items on his June 1931 installation (dsh3lz2Vo3o, ihuVuDwax3k) and this president-elect item. No radio recording of the 13 May 1931 Congress found. Le Temps dated 14 May 1931 (bpt6k2483375) went to press before the result.

media.title: France's New President (1932)
media.evidence: FALLBACK newsreel (no radio found). oEmbed 200, author 'British Pathé' (official channel); description full title: 'France's New President. 61 year-old M. Albert Lebrun - of peasant stock from Lorraine - elected to succeed late M. Paul Doumer.' Exact release date not stated (May 1932).

alternatives.title: Le Temps
alternatives.evidence: OAIRecord dc:date 1932-05-12 (Numéro 25827); f1.item title 'Le Temps | 1932-05-12'. ContentSearch page 1: 'Majorité absolue 389 Ont obtenu MM. ALBERT LEBRUN 633 suffrages' (OCR 'C33'); page 2: 'Lebrun est donc élu par le consentement de tous les partis'. searched: INA ina.fr search (audio+video: 'Lebrun', 'Albert Lebrun', 'élection Lebrun', 'Lebrun élu', 'Lebrun 1932', 'Versailles 1932') - no 1932 election audio or newsreel online; Gallica SRU sound recordings 'Lebrun' (only unrelated records); YouTube ('Albert Lebrun élu président 1932', ArchivesRadio) - British Pathé (chosen), ArchivesRadio Pathé-Journal copy, Archivio Luce VWy9ErNfplE (Italian Giornale Luce of 20/05/1932).
